task.goal: Add the following songs, in order, City of Stars, Dreamer's Awake, Moonlight Sonata, Echoes of Silence, Forever Young to my playing queue in Retro music.
task.final_summary: All five songs are in your Retro Music playing queue, in the order you asked: City of Stars, Dreamer's Awake, Moonlight Sonata, Echoes of Silence, Forever Young. I re-read the queue list once after adding them and it holds exactly these five entries in that order.

steps.note: Observe current screen to find Retro Music app
Open Songs tab and search for City of Stars
Open City of Stars menu and choose Add to playing queue
Confirm City of Stars added to queue, then add Dreamer's Awake
Tap Add to playing queue for Dreamer's Awake
Add Moonlight Sonata to playing queue
Tap Add to playing queue for Moonlight Sonata
Add Echoes of Silence to playing queue
Tap Add to playing queue for Echoes of Silence
Add Forever Young to playing queue
Tap Add to playing queue for Forever Young
Open the playing queue to verify order
Open now playing screen to inspect queue
Confirm queue contains exactly the 5 songs in order, then done
Task complete; queue verified with 5 songs in order
